Services

One studio.
Eleven ways
to tell it.

A flexible production partner for moving image, still photography and visual communication — from a single location shot to long-term site documentation.

01

Custom B-roll

For filmmakers & news media

Specific footage, captured to fit your narrative. We help remote and independent teams get the setting, action and texture they need without moving an entire crew.

02

Virtual video tours

Make distance disappear

Show facilities, equipment and capabilities with an experience audiences can revisit — useful across education, healthcare, manufacturing and more.

03

Product videos

Clarity drives action

Compelling demonstrations that reveal features, build confidence and help customers make informed decisions.

04

Explainer videos

Complex, made clear

Training, process flows, safety procedures, product features and DIY content shaped into focused, easy-to-follow narratives.

05

Drone cinematography

A new point of view

Aerial imagery for film, real estate, events and industrial inspection — adding scale and perspective without the cost of traditional aircraft.

06

Photography

Your image, not a stock image

Brand-specific photography of products, people, spaces and culture, created for consistency and authenticity across every channel.

07

Animated visual systems for marketing, advertising and presentations that make ideas more dynamic and easier to understand.

08

09

Months in a moment

10

Site monitoring

See progress. Protect investment.

Ongoing construction documentation that supports oversight and creates a valuable visual record for future promotion.

11

Testimonial videos

Trust, in their own words

Carefully produced interviews that keep the human voice at the center and turn customer experience into credible brand proof.

About

Small by
design. Wide
in scope.

Kenira Inc. is a full-service custom video production and still photography company serving clients and industries with distinct visual needs.

Our approach

We begin with the outcome, not a preset package. Then we shape the crew, tools and visual language around what the audience needs to understand, feel or do next.

Industries

Different worlds.
One visual standard.

01

Real estate

Dynamic property photography, video tours, drone footage and progress films designed to create a strong first impression.

02

Travel & tourism

Destination imagery that captures atmosphere and local character — made with intentional light, movement and perspective.

03

Industrial & manufacturing

Production stories that show operations, products and capabilities for marketing, training, internal communication and fundraising.

How we work
01

Listen for the real brief.

We find the purpose behind the deliverable before the cameras come out.

02

Build only what it needs.

A right-sized team keeps the work focused, flexible and efficient.

03

Make every frame useful.

Creative decisions serve the story, the audience and the channel.
